regression_slice.definition: every rawlsing_next/tests file importing the binder or any module transitively reachable from it, computed by parsing imports rather than by hand
regression_slice.new_file_excluded_from_both_sides: test_pre553_service_f8_binding_authentication_court.py -- it has no pre-existing baseline, so it was excluded from both runs
regression_slice.method: controlled before/after on the SAME 74 pre-existing files. The three modified files were reverted to their committed state and the new court moved out of the tree to establish the baseline, __pycache__ purged, and the identical file list re-run. Failure and error identity was compared as SORTED SETS, not by aggregate count. The repaired files were then restored and their SHA-256 checksums verified identical to the saved working copies before the second run.
regression_slice.conclusion: The authentication repair introduced zero new failures and changed zero existing failures. All 139 pre-existing failing/error identities are unrelated to the binder, its courts, or the three adopted owners, and are byte-for-byte the same set before and after.
regression_slice.why_they_were_not_repaired: they are out of this lane's commissioned scope. Repairing them would exceed the bounded repair set and would risk unrelated behaviour.

owner_preservation.verified_independently_of_the_courts: by git hash-object in the shell as well as inside both binding courts and the new authentication court

write_terrain.diff_stat: 288 insertions, 149 deletions across three modified files, plus one new court
write_terrain.forbidden_power_scan: the diff was scanned for added ranking, selection, priority, preference, weight, pooling, composition, respondent linkage and actor terms; the only matches were negative disclaimer prose such as 'grants no selection'. No new authority was added.

api_change_disclosed.what_changed: the signature of the authority-consuming entry points
api_change_disclosed.before: evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility(binding, query, rule, evidence, receipt=None); assert_query_source_admitted(query); expose_unranked_admitted_source_set()
api_change_disclosed.after: evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility(binding, request, receipt, query, rule, evidence); assert_query_source_admitted(query, request=, receipt=, rule=); expose_unranked_admitted_source_set(request=, receipt=, rule=)
api_change_disclosed.why: the commission requires the exact request and authoritative receipt at the authority-consuming path. receipt was previously optional, which is precisely what let the receipt checks be skipped.
api_change_disclosed.who_is_affected: any caller of these three entry points must now supply the authoritative request, receipt and rule. This is a deliberate, disclosed breaking change: it is the repair.
api_change_disclosed.call_sites_updated_in_this_lane: all call sites in the two existing binding courts, plus the new authentication court
api_change_disclosed.call_sites_outside_those_courts_found: none; the transitive import closure over rawlsing_next/tests showed no other consumer of these entry points
api_change_disclosed.removed_reason_code: BINDING_RULE_REPLAY_MISMATCH became unreachable once authentication was added and was removed rather than left as dead vocabulary; a tampered rule now refuses with BINDING_REPLAY_MISMATCH during authentication.
